title: 4 Packaging Trends From PACK EXPO Changing How Manufacturers Think About Adhesives

## 4 Packaging Trends From PACK EXPO Changing How Manufacturers Think About Adhesives


Manufacturers in the consumer-packaged goods (CPG) industry are influenced by rising material costs, sustainability goals and the need for increased productivity and throughput. As a result, many are reevaluating their packaging operations to identify areas for improvement.


At PACK EXPO, one area that generated discussions were adhesive applications. While adhesives may not always be top of mind for manufacturers, the way they are applied can have a direct impact on costs, efficiency and package quality.


#### Trend 1: Rising material costs


As material costs continue to rise alongside changes to the supply chain and packaging demands, manufacturers are starting to focus on the total cost of ownership instead of just upfront equipment costs. Areas of focus include:


-


Adhesive usage and waste reduction


-


Energy efficiency


-


Cost per unit


To combat rising costs, manufacturers are looking for ways to make adhesive applications more efficient. By optimizing how adhesive is dispensed, manufacturers can reduce waste and control costs without changing the adhesive itself.


#### Trend 2: Sustainable packaging


Sustainability remains a key focus of packaging decisions across the CPG industry. One trend discussed at PACK EXPO was the continued shift toward paper-based packaging materials.


As manufacturers adopt new packaging materials, they also need adhesive application processes that can produce reliable seals on different materials.


Reliable adhesive systems can help manufacturers:


-


Deliver consistent seal quality


-


Minimize adhesive waste


-


Support sustainability goals


-


Maintain performance expectations


As packaging evolves, manufacturers need to know their adhesive applications are keeping up and sealing effectively.


#### Trend 3: Uptime and throughput


Among all the trends mentioned at PACK EXPO, one theme that was consistently mentioned was uptime.


For many manufacturers, maintaining production throughput is a top priority. While adhesive dispensing systems have an important part in end-of-line packaging, keeping those systems running is equally important.


Depending on the system design, equipment, operating conditions and maintenance practices, adhesive dispensing equipment can present challenges such as:


-


Clogged nozzles


-


Adhesive char buildup


-


Cleaning requirements


-


Startup delays


-


Temperature inconsistency


By choosing the correct adhesive dispensing equipment, manufacturers can reduce maintenance-related downtime, increase uptime and keep production lines operating more efficiently.


#### Trend 4: Technology advancements and automation


Automation was another topic at PACK EXPO that CPG manufacturers are focusing on. As newer solutions become available, many manufacturers are replacing more manual processes and older equipment with automated adhesive dispensing systems.


An automated approach can provide several benefits:


-


Repeatable adhesive patterns


-


Improved seal quality


-


Reduced adhesive use


-


Fewer quality issues


-


Less operator intervention


Automated processes provide more control and help manufacturers apply the right amount of adhesive. This consistency can improve operational efficiency while helping ensure package quality is up to business standards.


#### Adhesive optimization as a competitive advantage


As manufacturers continue to navigate industry pressures and company initiatives, optimizing adhesive applications has become a focus to improve operational efficiency. By having the right equipment on the production line, manufacturers can better support performance without changing the adhesive material used.
